note: The template. The station works on its own copy (--config, default ~/kode-factory/test_dot_station.json), made from this file on first use. ssid_24 and ssid_5 are the two networks of the place where the station stands; their channels are filled in by test_dot_final.py --discover. A threshold of null only records the RSSI: the criterion is that each network and the beacon are heard. station names the station in the exit record and in the CSV's name. expect.kodeos is the version every Kode must run to pass (as `info` prints it); a factory run refuses to start without it, a bench run accepts any. parallel_with_operator lists what the PC does while the operator presses and touches. sd_images names what the Kode installs from the station's microSD: welcome and storage, each with its file and its sha256, and welcome optionally with the version the Kode must leave with; a factory run refuses to start without both, a bench run with null installs nothing. The station checks each file's SHA-256 on the Kode's microSD before the run and installs it only when it matches. place.window is the camera window of the last good placement, kept by the program.
